name: SSCC Apia cable landing station (Tui-Samoa / Manatua landings)
notes: SSCC RIO effective 1 Jan 2026 defines the Apia cable station and offers colocation/interconnection access guidelines to OOTR-licensed providers; SSCC progress page shows 100% (Tui-Samoa launched Feb 2018 per ADB/OOTR; Manatua Nov 2019). Flexenclosure (trade press, B) supplied eCentre modular data-centre cable landing stations terminating Tui-Samoa at Vavaisse (Upolu, near Apia; ADB IEEA names Fagali'i) and Tuasivi. Classified telecom_cable_station / colo-adjacent interconnection per WS methodology - not a public retail datacenter. SSCC offers Leased Capacity/IRU/Facility Access Agreements.

name: Government of Samoa Data Center (Digitally Connected and Resilient Samoa Project, DCRSP P180807)
developer: Government of Samoa / MCIT and OOTR (executed via Ministry of Finance); World Bank grant US$20m
notes: DCRSP Component 1 includes 'upgrade and establishment of secure and resilient government data center' plus national fibre and Government Intranet enhancement (MCIT official page). World Bank ISR indicators (data-centre capacity, renewable energy consumed in government data center) still show 0 current progress in 2026 snapshots with targets to Oct 2029; no procurement/completion record found, so status stays planned/implementation-stage. Site not officially disclosed - likely Tuamasaga (Apia) but that is inference; no capacity assigned.

name: Apia operator/ISP telecom core premises (SamoaTel, Digicel Samoa, Vodafone Samoa, CSL) - lead
developer: SamoaTel Ltd; Digicel Samoa (Telstra Pacific since 2022-07-14); Vodafone Samoa; Computer Services Limited (CSL)
notes: OOTR (A) licenses SamoaTel, Digicel, Vodafone, CSL, BlueWave, Starlink Samoa Ltd etc., proving operator existence, not facilities. No primary source in this run names a switch/gateway/NOC/server facility for these operators in Apia; CSL (csl.ws) is a locally owned ISP offering broadband, backups, network infrastructure and Starlink retail but no named hosting/data-centre facility page. Recorded as telecom_core/ISP lead (C) - do not count as datacenter. Starlink Samoa Ltd is connectivity-only (negative control).

name: SSCC Tuasivi cable landing station (Tui-Samoa Savai'i landing)
notes: SSCC RIO 2026 defines the Tuasivi cable station (Savai'i) with colocation/interconnection access guidelines; ADB IEEA confirms Tuasivi on Savai'i as Samoa landing point; Flexenclosure (B) supplied the eCentre cable landing station there; Tui-Samoa operational since Feb 2018. Classified telecom_cable_station (only non-Apia A-grade facility lead per WS methodology). Salelologa commercial/utility presence nearby is not datacenter evidence.
